skill.name: peer-review
skill.description: Structured manuscript and grant review with checklist-based evaluation for methods, statistics, reporting standards, reproducibility, ethics, and constructive feedback.
skill.summary: Guide rigorous, constructive peer review for scientific manuscripts, grants, and presentations.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from scientific review terminology and Markdown fences. Two findings are confirmed because the skill instructs agents to run local Python scripts through Bash, and one low-severity semantic issue notes external service steering for confidential workflows.

remediation.issue: Shell examples execute local Python scripts from the skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running these commands, validate input paths, escape user-provided descriptions, and document expected script locations.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends a hosted external platform for complex manuscript workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Add a confidentiality warning and require user consent before suggesting that unpublished manuscripts, grants, or private data be moved to any external service.

content.value_statement: Peer review requires consistent checks across methods, statistics, ethics, and reporting. This skill guides structured, constructive reviews for manuscripts, grants, and scientific presentations.
actual_capabilities: Guides section-by-section assessment of abstracts, methods, results, discussion, references, and figures.
Checks statistical rigor, sample size justification, missing data handling, and multiple testing practices.
Evaluates reproducibility, data availability, code availability, ethics, and conflicts of interest.
Maps study types to reporting standards such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.
Structures peer review reports with summary statements, major comments, minor comments, and questions for authors.
Provides a presentation review workflow that inspects slide images for layout, readability, and content issues.
limitations: It does not replace a qualified subject-matter reviewer or journal editor.
It needs the manuscript, proposal, figures, or slides to make specific comments.
It cannot verify raw data, code execution results, or ethical approvals unless evidence is provided.
Optional script-based workflows require local tools, available scripts, and user approval before execution.

use_cases.title: Journal Manuscript Review
use_cases.description: Prepare a balanced peer review that identifies major validity concerns, minor clarity issues, and actionable revision requests.

use_cases.title: Grant Proposal Evaluation
use_cases.description: Assess significance, approach, feasibility, reproducibility, and ethical considerations before panel discussion.

use_cases.title: Internal Pre-Submission Review
use_cases.description: Help research teams find statistical, reporting, and presentation gaps before journal or funder submission.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Manuscript Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a complete manuscript.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript as a constructive peer reviewer. Summarize the study, list major concerns, list minor concerns, and give a clear recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Methods and Statistics Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused technical review of rigor and validity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the methods and statistical analysis in this manuscript. Focus on design, controls, sample size, assumptions, missing data, multiple testing, and reproducibility.

prompt_templates.title: Reporting Standards Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Checklist-driven review for a specific study type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this study against the appropriate reporting guideline. Identify missing checklist items, unclear reporting, and revisions needed for transparent publication.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Editorial Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Full decision-oriented review for editors or panels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a formal peer review with a summary, novelty assessment, methodological critique, statistical critique, ethics review, reproducibility assessment, prioritized revisions, and confidential editor notes.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks for a formal assessment of an observational cohort manuscript.
output: Summary: The study addresses an important clinical question, but key design details are underreported.
Major concern: Confounding control is unclear, and sensitivity analyses are needed to support the main conclusion.
Minor concern: Figure legends should define abbreviations and report sample sizes for each panel.

output_examples.input: A research team requests a pre-submission review of a grant proposal.
output: Strength: The proposal has a clear scientific premise and a feasible recruitment plan.
Risk: The power calculation does not match the stated primary endpoint.
Revision: Align aims, endpoints, statistical tests, and contingency plans before submission.

output_examples.input: A presenter asks for feedback on a scientific slide deck.
output: Overall: The narrative is logical, but several slides need readability improvements.
Layout issue: Some axis labels and captions are too small for a live presentation.
Content issue: The conclusion slide should distinguish supported findings from future hypotheses.

best_practices: Provide the manuscript type, target venue, review criteria, and any required reporting guideline.
Ask for prioritized major and minor comments so authors can act on the most important issues first.
Include figures, tables, supplements, and protocol details when requesting reproducibility or reporting checks.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a publication recommendation without sharing the venue standards or decision criteria.
Do not treat checklist completion as proof that the science is valid.
Do not request confidential or unpublished material to be shared with external services without permission.

faq.question: Can this skill write a complete peer review?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure a review with a summary, major comments, minor comments, questions, and a recommendation.

faq.question: Does it support grant review?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess significance, approach, feasibility, rigor, ethics, and reproducibility for grant proposals.

faq.question: Which reporting standards does it reference?
faq.answer: It references standards such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, MINSEQE, SPIRIT, and CARE.

faq.question: Can it evaluate statistics?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks assumptions, effect sizes, power, missing data, multiple testing, and exploratory analysis labeling.

faq.question: Can it review presentation slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a slide review workflow for readability, layout, structure, visual design, and scientific content.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the manuscript or proposal, figures, tables, supplemental files, venue criteria, and the intended review format.
